items.title: Cal Collins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 11, 1997
items.q: I call him the redhead, or the farmer — I call him the farmer once in a while because he was born in Farmersville, Texas. He calls me a hillbilly and I call him a farmer.

ctx.x: Oh. “The redhead?” Is that what you call him?
I call him the redhead, or the farmer — I call him the farmer once in a while because he was born in Farmersville, Texas. He calls me a hillbilly and I call him a farmer.
Well you’ve been around the country, you’ve lived in a number of places. You moved to L.A. for a while, is that right?
